nodes.name: GenLayer
nodes.tagline: Synthetic jurisdiction for AI-era contracts and digital disputes.
nodes.description: GenLayer resolves ambiguous digital outcomes with Intelligent Contracts and AI-driven judicial consensus. It gives applications a way to move beyond binary logic when the real world requires judgment, interpretation, and evidence-based decisions.

evaluation.label: Curated ecosystem entry
evaluation.note: Seeded by the ecosystem map maintainers; not a paid Bradbury submission.

nodes.name: GenLayer Ecosystem Map
nodes.tagline: This ecosystem app's own repository was submitted on Bradbury for a paid GenLayer evaluation.
nodes.description: A live Bradbury submission proving the paid verification flow end to end. The repository was submitted with 1 GEN to the previous EcosystemRegistry contract and finalized with a GenLayer execution error; future submissions use 0.042 GEN after redeploying a patched registry that verifies websites without inventing graph links.

evaluation.label: Finalized with execution error
evaluation.note: Live transaction submitted to the previous EcosystemRegistry.submit_player(url) and finalized with an execution error. Payment requested evaluation, not guaranteed placement; patched redeploys should use 0.042 GEN.

nodes.name: Rally
nodes.tagline: AI-powered marketing protocol for performance-based influence.
nodes.description: Rally lets campaigns define rules in natural language and rewards creators based on judged performance. Projects deposit funds, contributors publish content, and GenLayer-backed evaluation decides whether work qualifies and how rewards should be distributed.

evaluation.label: Curated ecosystem entry
evaluation.note: Seeded by the ecosystem map maintainers; not a paid Bradbury submission.

nodes.name: Argue.fun
nodes.tagline: Argumentation market where stronger reasoning wins.
nodes.description: Argue.fun is a debate market where participants stake on a position and AI consensus judges which side made the stronger case. It turns subjective reasoning into a market mechanic while leaning on GenLayer-style evaluation.

evaluation.label: Curated ecosystem entry
evaluation.note: Seeded by the ecosystem map maintainers; not a paid Bradbury submission.

nodes.name: InternetCourt
nodes.tagline: Dispute resolution for the agent economy.
nodes.description: InternetCourt is a case interface for AI-agent disputes. Parties submit evidence, an GenLayer consensus evaluates the record, and the resulting verdict can route back into escrow or application logic. It is the visible courtroom surface for GenLayer-powered adjudication.

evaluation.label: Curated ecosystem entry
evaluation.note: Seeded by the ecosystem map maintainers; not a paid Bradbury submission.

nodes.name: MergeProof
nodes.description: MergeProof applies economically backed review to software collaboration. Reviewers stake behind PR evaluations, bug hunters are rewarded for catching issues, and judgment becomes legible, incentive-aligned, and contestable.

evaluation.label: Curated ecosystem entry
evaluation.note: Seeded by the ecosystem map maintainers; not a paid Bradbury submission.

nodes.name: Intelligent Oracle
nodes.tagline: External data integration layer for GenLayer.
nodes.description: Intelligent Oracle (intelligentoracle.com) is your GenLayer integration hub. It pulls real-world signals—weather, crypto prices, sports scores, stock data—and packages them into verifiable on-chain inputs that contracts and juries can actually use. No more hard-coding or manual feeds.

evaluation.label: Curated ecosystem entry
evaluation.note: Seeded by the ecosystem map maintainers; not a paid Bradbury submission.

nodes.name: Agent Market Demo
nodes.tagline: Example project accepted after a paid Bradbury evaluation.
nodes.description: A mock evaluated ecosystem entry showing how a project can pay for GenLayer to verify that a website is live, real, and GenLayer-related while the creator supplies relationship claims. This is demo data, not a live endorsement.

evaluation.label: Evaluated by GenLayer
evaluation.note: Demo evaluation: relevance and information quality passed the display threshold. Paying requests verification; it does not guarantee placement or canonical graph links.

nodes.name: Thin Submission
nodes.tagline: Example of a paid submission still awaiting enough signal.
nodes.description: A mock needs-review entry illustrating that Bradbury payment starts verification, but thin or ambiguous projects are not automatically accepted and their relationship claims remain contestable.

evaluation.label: Needs review
evaluation.note: Demo evaluation: related enough to preserve, but not enough public evidence for default graph prominence.
